classes: the 46 class profiles and 48 class settings of M1/M3 (16 settings left out of the batch: see why)
handlers: every handler of M1 and M3: 110 handlers over 28 nodes

batches.why: The commonly used journal, conference and student classes among the first 48 settings, by the ar5iv class tally (https://gist.github.com/dginev/a642cbc6ae106786d24e2f271cf2941d), publisher volumes (OpenAlex) and Overleaf's template tags. Left out as rarely used or out of scope: minimal, ltxdoc, proc (test, documentation, obsolete); letter, scrlttr2, moderncv (letters, CVs); a0poster, tikzposter (posters); extbook, extreport, amsbook, amsproc, tufte-book, ctexbeamer, ctexrep (covered by a sibling that stays); easychair (not on CTAN, licence unstated, little use).

The most used classes not in batch 1 that are on CTAN and MiKTeX (fetched on demand), plus three settings of batch 1 classes in their other common modes. To ship once their licence headers allow it: iopart (27k on arXiv), svjour3 (15.6k), PoS (9.9k), imsart (4.5k). After that: mitthesis, bxjsarticle, elegantbook, iacrj, aiaa, ametsoc, jmlr, quantumarticle, and the publisher classes that must be shipped. Venues that use article with a style file (ACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, AAAI, CVPR, IJCAI, USENIX, JHEP) become setups on article.
